canonicalStoreRecommendation.form: versioned JSON/JSONL node-edge dataset or equivalent relational graph

caseStressTests.case-008: Section/grammar identity and unit scope are not file-global.
caseStressTests.case-009: Package survey membership and canonical locked-source admissibility are different states; file identity is context/provenance-bearing.
caseStressTests.case-010: Main ledger and embedded remarks-side tables must remain separate structures, including their local units.
